schema: data/moves v1 (style of throwdown.json): every number = {v, basis}; basis = sample id + skeleton field + frame/time
conventions: ref angles: knee 0 = straight, torso_lean 0 = upright, arm_abd 0 = arm hanging, elbow 0 = straight (MediaPipe skeleton). game.* knee = interior angle (180 = straight) as in rider.js. t = clip time (0 = user segment start).

view.travel: 远离镜头（方向沿用上一段，同一镜头里板不会掉头）

segment_notes: 2.9 s user segment = ~4 cross-steps walking up the board (vision on the mp4: crossings at ~0.5-0.7, 1.3-1.5, 1.9-2.1 s, feet end near the nose). t 2.17 is a non-ok frame and f69 a detection glitch (knee_R 129.5, ankle_dy 0.8) — excluded; 2.2-2.5 s torso 40 deg + right arm 90 deg = a reach/lean at the end, not part of the step cycle. World-coordinate ankle order along the hip line is too noisy at 45 deg to count crossings (only 3 sign changes); step timing comes from the knee-flexion peaks of the stepping leg.

stance.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 view.stance; refskel stance() falls back to the head method (travel = away from camera) — head method over t 0..0.5 votes L 11 / R 3, so the skeleton does NOT confirm goofy: treat front foot as unknown, mirror freely

step_period_s.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 ang.knee_L/knee_R local peaks >24 deg in t 0..2.1, median spacing; peaks at t [0.77, 0.83, 1.2, 1.23, 1.8]

knee_step_peak_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 median of those knee peaks (stepping leg lifts)

knee_support_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 ang.knee_L median (support / between steps) over t 0.0..2.1

torso_lean_peak_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 ang.torso_lean peak within t<=2.1 f32 t0.97 (smoothed 34.1, raw 34.9, half-height 0.8..1.0)

arm_abd_lead_peak_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 ang.arm_abd_L main peak (reaching arm) f25 t0.73 (smoothed 60.8, raw 63.9, half-height 0.7..0.97)

elbow_deg.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 ang.elbow_L+elbow_R mean of medians over t 0.0..2.1

ankle_dist_m.basis: pro_ARCk35WWnbk_38 ang.ankle_dist median (feet close: 0.0-0.3 m) over t 0.0..2.1

game._: proposed rider.js params for the dance cross-step (DANCE_K timing / dance arm targets). Not wired yet.

kneeStepLift.basis: 180 - ref.knee_step_peak_deg: stepping leg at its highest

torsoLean.basis: ref.torso_lean_deg (forward lean while walking the board)

armLeadAbd.basis: ref.arm_abd_lead_peak_deg capped at 70 (Cheney: outside arm about shoulder height, bent elbow, never overhead)
